text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 剧场侧门.
Environment: Theatre side entrance with service door, steps and exterior masonry, quiet backstage access lane.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / spatial production design.
Asset: Vicky environment library, scene-004-01, 剧场侧门, 三维图. Generate one finished independent image, landscape 1536x1024 or larger.
Input image 1 is the existing environment identity reference. Reference board has 2 columns and 2 rows. Use ONLY top-left for this location; ignore all other places.
Any additional reference is the same scene's concept floor/site plan and is the geometric source of truth. Keep its footprint, entrances, openings, adjacencies, landmark arrangement and orientation fixed.
Request: One large high-angle orthographic axonometric 3D spatial cutaway/dollhouse diagram with roof removed and near walls cut away so space connections and height levels are clear. Match the supplied approved layout plan exactly. Preserve environment materials and palette, use unobtrusive white background outside the scene footprint. Keep meaningful terrain/context for exterior scenes. Show stairs, openings and furniture; discreet matching A B C D landmark keys. No extra plan or elevation panels.
Maintain the architecture, distinctive objects, material vocabulary and visual character of the original. Do not reuse the reference board as the output. Rationally extrapolate only unseen geometry; it is a coherent concept reconstruction for story staging, not surveyed construction documentation. Use one internally consistent space, not a collage of unrelated rooms. Walls meet logically, doors connect traversable spaces, no blocked entrances or impossible staircases. NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO silhouettes, NO human figures in reflections or posters, NO logos/watermarks. Small legible English labels only where useful. Avoid busy ornament, repeated generic layouts and unexplained disconnected rooms.
Original design context (use only details compatible with target reference panel): 别演，吻我 · 剧场侧门／街角咖啡店／车站／试镜室 · 纯环境修订

STRICT SPATIAL SCOPE: Draw ONLY the target location 剧场侧门. Treat every other reference-board panel as a different unrelated location. Do not import props, cages, benches, stairs, furniture or rooms from other panels. Extrapolate only the immediate target footprint. Do NOT assemble a whole multi-function complex. For a room, confine plan to that room, with adjoining rooms dashed and unshown. For outdoor space show only site boundary and immediately bounding facades, no invented building interiors.
REFERENCE OVERRIDE: Image1 is plan, Image2 contains the original theater door in TOP LEFT panel only. Follow plan simple footprint of one wall, stage door and sidewalk. Use old brick, warm practical lights, wet city pavement. All other source panels are unrelated. Label cameras A B C D, no compass. No people.
